name: The Horrids
bio:
Radikal Moodz and Shred'er combine the best of their imagination into a fresh style with energetic basslines and grooves, surrounded by organic textures broken by digital rhythms. Together they build a full 3D world to travel inside, unique of its kind.

A fairy-tale journey with twisted sounds, off-beat sequences and crazy sound design.

name: Anchronorium
bio:
Anchronorium is the DarkPsy project of Portuguese producer Rafyx, exploring high-intensity soundscapes built on dissonant textures, immersive atmospheres, and fast, driving rhythms. His music blends detailed sound design with a cinematic sense of darkness, creating deep mental journeys and powerful nighttime energy on the dancefloor.
With a signature style marked by high BPMs, hypnotic storytelling and dense psychedelic layers, Anchronorium delivers a modern and impactful interpretation of the dark psychedelic spectrum. The project continues to evolve with new releases and performances, establishing a strong and distinctive presence within contemporary DarkPsy.

name: Balku
bio:
Directly from the prestigious label Transubtil Records, Balku brings his unique energy and unmistakable sound to guide us in a transcendental experience.
At just 23 years old, this young talent is already standing out on the forest and darkpsy scenes, captivating hearts and minds wherever he goes.
His music is an intense fusion of hypnotic textures, deep beats and immersive atmospheres, transporting us to a dimension where dance and connexion with nature becomes one.
From his soul to your brain, Balku is Andre Varandas from coimbra, Portugal.

name: La Marquise
bio:
La Marquise, or Angélo, has been creating music for over fifteen years.
He discovered psytrance in 2012 and immediately fell in love with the genre, drawn above all by its textures and sonic richness. His style sits somewhere between groovy night psy and slightly darker atmospheres, while maintaining a playful, mischievous and driving energy. La Marquise crafts live sets where movement, sonic substance and surprise are at the heart of the experience. In 2019, he joined the Transubtil Records label. His first EP, Precisely Nowhere, was released in 2023. He also recorded two sets for Radiozora, in 2020 and 2022, and has contributed to numerous compilations over the years.
La Marquise is a constantly evolving project, driven by a passion for sound and a desire to take listeners on a journey.

name: Opsuruus
bio:
Sandro Viegas from Portugal, is the creative mind behind Opsuruus, one of the rising names in the new generation of portuguese darkpsy and darkforest artists.
His music unfolds through unpredictable moments, always guided by a core concept:  contrast.
Contrast of feelings, atmospheres and sonic textures.
He is known for delivering infections energy on the dancefloor, blending hypnotic drive with bursts of pure, controlled insanity that takes the audience on an intense and vibrant journey.
Sandro had the privilege of learning from artists such as Grub, Rawar, Ulvae, Gandhabba who played an important role throughout his artistic path.
With focus, dedication and an increasingly defined identity, Opsuruus promises a path full of evolution and power.

name: Warp Drive
bio:
Tim aka Warp Drive is a psytrance project hailing from the sunny shores of Sydney, Australia.
Bootstrapped in the late 2010’s following many sleepless nights in the woods, it is a mince of cultural influences packes into a night psy skin. Bon appétit !

name: Xipe Totecs
bio:
Xipe totecs is the Psytrance project from Japan, who started in 2018.
They decided to keep exploring music from the"rave"scene, producing powerful sounds.
Their universe encompasses epic themes and colorful frenzied drums, to create trance music full of new sororities. 
In 2020, they signed to the French label Transubtil records

They released  their first EP ‘Evil in the shell’ in June 2022 which reached number 1 in several music charts. In the same year they started touring in Mexico, Brazil and Europe. Overcoming the global pandemic, the band has been active in Japan and abroad

name: Zeo
bio: Candice aka Zeo started mixing Pystrance in 2016. Reasoning influences Dark, Forest but also very Groovy. It was in 2018 that she embarked on music production. Keeping the aim of making his audience travel through his emotions, his influences and his musical perception. What she likes about this style is its side, both dark but colorful, hypnotic, absorbing but also very energetic. That we can live introspectively or on the contrary, hyper communicative and synergistic. After a few years of preparation for her Live, today she is finally ready to reveal the plots of her little universe.

name: Agop
bio:
AGOP is a DJ, producer and sound engineer who grew up within alternative artistic communities and was exposed to electronic music from an early age. This environment sparked a lasting fascination for psychedelic sounds, leading him to start DJing as a teenager. 
His first steps behind the decks took place at private parties — a formative playground where he refined his technique and developed his connection with a passionate crowd.
Today, his project explores the many facets of the psytrance spectrum, blending groove, energy and
hypnotic atmospheres. As a professional sound technician, he also holds a strong interest in the
technical side of music, working on live sound for bands as well as several electronic and psytrance festivals. In 2025, he played at Hadra Trance Festival and joined Transubtil Records

name: Akhaba
bio:
Antoine, Akhaba, Kubba, is a DJ, producer, and sound engineer from the south of France, passionate about modern psychedelic music for more than a decade. 
A true propagator of sound, his performances adapt to the moment and the energy of the dancefloor ; seducing underground crowds while keeping his music accessible to a wider audience. 
Now part of Transubtil Records, Akhaba delivers powerful night-time psytrance: groovy, dark, and immersive. His sound remains firmly rooted in the dancefloor yet unfolds as a unique reflective journey captivating both body and mind. Kubba is Antoine’s techno-driven project. A true laboratory of exploration, his DJ sets travel through techno, psy-techno, and even quirky shades of tech house. With Kubba, every performance is eclectic, unpredictable, and always a joyful playground behind the decks.

name: Art2Fly
bio:
Eduardo Ramírez Herrera, also known as Art2Fly. 
He started as a DJ in 2010. He is originally from Tabasco and currently resides in Yucatán, Mexico.
He co-founded Trance México in 2018 and joined the French label Transubtil Records in 2020.

name: DJ Lazzzy
bio:
Actively organizing and support parties in Japan regardless of size, he is founder or 0=zero production
In summer of 2019 he Joined French label Transubtil records in pursuit of innovative sounds, and started a new adventure... He produced and released his first compilation album [New wave Killer] on the label with friends.
He is very active in the Japanese scene, uniting the different crews through tours, releases  and parties.
In 2025, he released his second compilation album ‘Ultra Heaven” building a bridge between the Japanese and French scenes organizing a tour in Japan

name: Fiorenza
bio:
Integrating the feminine underground scene of the Cerrado, Fiorenza transforms nocturnal sound into a powerful expression of feeling. 
Moving between 155 and 170 BPM, her sets traverse the textures of Forest and Dark, crafting a psychedelic sonic journey with heavy basslines and immersive atmospheres.

name: Heavy Fawn
bio:
Heavy Fawn is the Nightpsy DJ project of Hugo, originally from Marseille, France. He discovered the world of psytrance and free parties in 2009, where he instantly fell in love with the music..In 2017, he met Tantra Music, began collaborating with them as a DJ and organizer, and together they made some of the best darkpsy festivals in southern France. In 2020, he joined the French label Transubtil Records and played in Mexico and Costa Rica. He later joined the Brazilian label Resina Records in 2024, from which he had drawn major inspiration for years. His first VA is set to be released in early 2026, a collaboration between Resina and Transubtil Records featuring only exclusive tracks.
His goal is to create DJ sets that are neither forest, nor dark, nor twilight, nor hightech, but a perfect blend that is purely psychedelic.

name: Jive
bio:
Jive is the DJ project of Jai Royall, representing Transubtil Records.
Spawning in 2017, the project was developed as a tool to research and further understand the symbiosis between unearthly sonic textures and deep rhythmic structures.

Jive is also the co-founder of Murky Collective and event director of Swampy Conscience.
Catch Jive generating forest portals up n around the eastern coast of Oz.

name: Kanaloa
bio:
Marcus is the DJ and producer behind the psytrance project, Kanaloa. He has been playing at events and festivals across the Western Hemisphere for over 20 years, playing all around the UK, Europe, His dedication to mastering the art of psychedelic sound and creating unique experiences has driven him to delve deep into the world of psychedelic music.
Representing Transubtil Records, Kanaloa drives atmospheric and deep sounds, combining distorted textures with forest-friendly elements and organic soundscapes - enveloping imagination into a fresh new style.
Expect dark-edged and twisted night-time grooves.

name: Mekanorms
bio:
Marcus is the DJ and producer behind the psytrance project, Kanaloa. He has been playing at events and festivals across the Western Hemisphere for over 20 years, playing all around the UK, Europe, His dedication to mastering the art of psychedelic sound and creating unique experiences has driven him to delve deep into the world of psychedelic music.
Representing Transubtil Records, Kanaloa drives atmospheric and deep sounds, combining distorted textures with forest-friendly elements and organic soundscapes - enveloping imagination into a fresh new style.
Expect dark-edged and twisted night-time grooves.

name: Pakkun
bio:
Pakkun alias Vincent has always been passionate about music, playing drums and bass guitar at a young age. Discovering electronic music through techno and d’n’b, he soon became in love with Psytrance.
Learning the art of djing with the Transubtil crew led him to integrate the label at the end of 2019 and play in Japan in summer 2022.

Constantly evolving, his sets range from groovy psytrance to darkpsy.
Now working a lot on the production side, he’s eager to show you his own vision of psytrance on his first releases.
He released his first compilation ‘Chaos Simulator’ containing his first release with Dr Fractal, more coming this year

name: Rajax
bio:
Since 2013, William really dived into the psytrance world, quickly a passion borned and his project RAJAX was born. His debut on stage was in 2015 with the Outrance association.
In 2017, he joined the Senoï Project association, In March 2019, supported by this association, he launched his first compilation titled "GENOME "
In 2023, he joined the growing label Transubtil Records, and starts delivering darker and faster DJ sets, yet his love for the groove remains intact. 
Each of his performances is unique and makes a strong impact on the dancefloors, confirming his place in the psytrance scene and creating unforgettable moments for the audience.

name: Wild Track
bio:
Wild Track is a Moroccan DJ, formerly known as DJ Gender Fluid. He is always crafting tailored DJ sets based on the vibe of the dancefloor, staying fully tuned in to its energy. Groovy and psychedelic, his mixes become the ideal soundtrack for active meditation, trance, and free-form dance. Immersed in the global psytrance scene as a festival traveler and party organizer long before stepping behind the decks, he developed an endless curiosity for digging the most powerful, groovy, and mind-shifting tracks. His mission: channel that same magic he once felt in the crowd and deliver it back to the dancefloor.
Deeply engaged in music, he is also the founder of Yaz Records and Universitek, an educational organization dedicated to sharing knowledge and nurturing creativity within the musical community.

name: Yagsa
bio:
Yagsa started mixing in  2010 after his discovery of trance in Hadra Festival.
In 2014 he joined the Transubil association and started performing in big dancefloors.
Now in the Transubtil Records Label, he released a compilationin collaboration with Mekanorms ‘Transsiberian’.
Come and discover his universe with forest and psychedelic atmospheres.
